title: Peas in a Pod
description: In the Falkland Islands (Islas Malvinas), these month-old elephant seals take one of their first dips in the ocean. Photographer Matty Smith was there to document the moment the mothers depart this famous breeding ground and return to the South Atlantic, leaving hundreds of babies, newly weaned, to fend for themselves.
translated_description: 在福克兰群岛（马尔维纳斯群岛），这些一个月大的象海豹首次跃入海洋。摄影师马蒂·史密斯记录下了这一时刻：母象海豹离开这片著名的繁殖地，返回南大西洋，留下数百只刚刚断奶的幼崽独自求生。
